newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Vocaltec estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Vocaltec estimate raised.

text.p: Lehman Brothers has raised its 1997 earnings estimate for Vocaltec Ltd after the Israeli firm, which makes software to enable voice and audio communication on the Internet, reported better-than-expected first-quarter results.
Vocaltec had a loss of $0.27 a share in the first quarter against Lehman's estimate of a $0.32 loss.
Lehman revised its full-year estimate to a loss of $0.87 a share from a loss of $0.92 and maintained its 1998 estimate calling for a loss of $0.26.
Lehman expects the company to turn profitable by the fourth quarter of 1998.
